candidate.source_summary: Input comes from linux kernel command line arguments parsed from /proc/cmdline, which can be influenced by system boot parameters but typically requires root/system access to modify
candidate.sink_summary: Direct assignment to object property using user-controlled key without prototype pollution protection

candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled key used in dynamic property assignment without prototype pollution safeguards, allowing modification of Object.prototype if key is '__proto__', 'constructor', or 'prototype'

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')

remediation_steps: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization
Use whitelisting approach for acceptable inputs
